issues: 29512, 29513, 29514, 29519, 29520, 29521: the cited Yuasa Vehicle Battery Range PDF returned 404; its specific supporting points could not be independently checked. Replace or restore the reference and verify each cited point.

29513, 29514: the Bosch evidence description says Bosch discourages grease on terminals without mentioning that the same handling procedure explicitly recommends petroleum jelly there. Accurately describe the source and qualify the type of protection according to manufacturer instructions.

29515: saying battery mass can affect energy and dynamics does not explain the adverse effect asserted in the true question. Explain a supported negative consequence, such as greater energy consumption for a given operation, consistently in all four languages; DOE chapter 13, pp. 13-11–12 discusses mass and energy consumption.

29521: the cited Fiat manual timed out and the cited Yuasa PDF returned 404.
